title: Pastelón de Plátano Maduro
description: Pastelón de Plátano Maduro is a dish from Dominican Republic featuring plantain, ground beef, yellow onion, garlic. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 16 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 35 minutes until set and cooked through.
